findings.title: Preflight wrapper creates the one-time campaign checkout before checking the plan commit, and `commands` accepts any plan commit
findings.evidence: The wrapper runs `bash "$TCN_CHECKOUT_SCRIPT"` (line 12), which creates $WORK/wearusfm_campaigns/pose_temponet_20261119. Only after that does it run `bash "$CODE_DIR/scripts/slurm/pose_temponet.sbatch"` (line 13). That second script is the first to check TCN_PLAN_COMMIT/TCN_PLAN_REPO_PATH and to run materialize-plan. materialize_plan (__main__.py:108-109) requires a 40-hex commit. `commands` (__main__.py:48, 156) only runs `git show <plan-commit>:<path>` on the Mac, which also accepts refs and short SHAs. Confirmed in a scratch repo: `commands --plan-commit HEAD ... --stage preflight` prints `TCN_PLAN_COMMIT=HEAD`, and `materialize-plan --commit HEAD ...` then fails with `ValueError: full plan commit/hash required`. campaign_checkout.sbatch exits 2 when DEST already exists. CODE_DIR/CAMPAIGN are reviewed constants in execution.py, and submit_command always uses this wrapper for preflight.
findings.failure_scenario: The operator passes `--plan-commit HEAD`, a short SHA, or a plan commit not yet pushed to leonardo. Any other failure between checkout and run_stage (B-1 included) has the same effect. The preflight job creates the campaign checkout, then fails in materialize-plan, with no receipt and no output. The re-submitted preflight dies immediately ('esiste gia''). There is no code path to reuse a complete checkout, and changing CAMPAIGN is a source change that needs a new review. One avoidable launcher error ends the campaign.
findings.suggested_fix: In pose_temponet_checkout.sbatch, before creating the checkout, validate TCN_PLAN_COMMIT as 40-hex and TCN_PLAN_REPO_PATH as relative with no `..`. Also check that `git -C "$WORK/wearusfm" show "$TCN_PLAN_COMMIT:$TCN_PLAN_REPO_PATH" | sha256sum` equals TCN_PLAN_SHA256. In `commands`, require --plan-commit to match `[0-9a-f]{40}`, as materialize_plan does. Optionally let the wrapper accept an existing, clean, read-only checkout at exactly CAMPAIGN_SHA, so preflight can be re-run after a recorded decision.

findings.title: The resource gate that releases WLS and the neural jobs uses the WORK quota measured at release-plan; `resource-plan` cannot record a fresh one
findings.stage: resource-plan (measured_plan) and every later stage via _resource_projection (wls_calibration through collection)
findings.evidence: _resource_projection reads `checks = plan.get("operator_checks", {})` (runner.py:119). Its own error message says 'current quota/pending-write measurements required'. It passes work_free_bytes/pending_write_bytes into resources.gate_and_pack, whose `quota` gate is `available >= 12*GIB+pending`. Those values are written only by release-plan (`result["operator_checks"] = operator_checks`, __main__.py:100), before preflight. The `resource-plan` parser accepts only --plan, --cpu-receipt, --gpu-receipt and --output (confirmed with --help). measured_plan (runner.py:145) and every later run_stage recompute the gate from the same release-time snapshot, and require it to equal plan['resource_gate'].
findings.failure_scenario: Between release and resource-plan, preflight and both benchmarks run; with queue waits this can take hours or days, and other lines on the shared 1 TB project quota keep writing to WORK. resource-plan still reports `quota: True` from the old measurement and releases WLS plus about 20 GPU-hours of fits that will write up to 8 GiB. Every later receipt records `gates.resources = True` as if the measurement were current. The operator can re-measure by hand, but there is no supported way to bind that measurement into the plan. Re-running release-plan only to update checks is undocumented.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `--operator-checks` to `resource-plan`. Validate it with `_operator_checks`, require its `observed_at` to be later than both benchmark receipts, and set `out['operator_checks']` and `out['operator_evidence']` before calling `_resource_projection` in measured_plan. Later stages then compare against this pinned post-benchmark measurement. Update step 6 of the delivery doc to match.
